Sub_heading: I build AI-powered applications, scalable backend systems and agentic workflows that solve real-world problems.
Who_I_Am: I'm a final-year B.Tech student in AI & Data Science with over a year of software engineering experience, building production-ready backend systems and AI-powered applications.

I work across Generative AI, RAG, multi-agent systems, and backend engineering. Currently, I'm focused on building scalable intelligent systems, exploring agentic AI, and strengthening my system design and data engineering skills.

projects.name: SmartShelf - MLOps Platform
projects.description: Architected a 3-model chained MLOps pipeline (Demand Forecasting → Price Optimisation → Inventory EOQ) achieving 85%+ forecast accuracy with 35+ engineered features. Designed a dual-layer data architecture: PostgreSQL (OLTP) for transactional data and BigQuery (OLAP) for analytics. Automated weekly retraining via Prefect with full model versioning in MLflow Registry. Deployed a FastAPI serving layer with Prometheus + Grafana monitoring, containerised via Docker with CI/CD on GitHub Actions.

projects.name: NOVA - Agentic AI System
projects.description: Designed a multi-agent AI system (CrewAI, 60+ tools) for autonomous task planning with a RAG pipeline (FAISS) for semantic retrieval and contextual memory. Packaged as a cross-platform desktop app via Electron with Firebase auth and real-time data sync.

projects.name: ClipHub - Media Platform
projects.description: An end-to-end media platform enabling creators to upload, stream, and organize short video and music content with leaderboards and challenges.

projects.name: GradeX - AI Coding Platform
projects.description: Real-time multiplayer coding platform with ELO matchmaking, LLM-driven problem generation via OpenRouter, and sandboxed code execution on Docker + AWS EC2.
